cases.name: signup, wrong password, login, scoped authorization and logout

argv: A="$1"; T=$("$A" --db a.db login --email bob@example.test --password 'correct horse battery' | sed 's/.*"token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/'); "$A" --db a.db authorize --token "$T" --scope self && ! "$A" --db a.db authorize --token "$T" --scope admin && "$A" --db a.db logout --token "$T" && ! "$A" --db a.db verify --token "$T"

cases.name: an unknown token is not a session
